body:
Could be cool to have a function that is able to generate an url from a "state".

Ex for magento: for now I need to do something like :

```
'#q=&page=0&refinements=%5B%7B%22categories%22%3A%5B%22'.$path.'%22%5D%7D%5D&numerics_refinements=%7B%7D&index_name=%22'.$indexName.'%22';
```

Could be cool to say something like:

```php
generateUrl({
 'refinements':<?php echo json_encode(['categories' => $path]); ?>,
 'index_name': '<?php echo $indexName; ?>'
}
```
